control_name: Message schemas are registered and version-pinned
control_objective: Every message schema used by policy and partner integrations is registered in the schema registry and pinned to an explicit version so that producers and consumers evolve compatibly.
risk_addressed: Unregistered or unpinned message schemas allow undetected breaking changes to propagate to consumers, causing message validation failures, data loss, and integration outages across the carrier and agency estate.

applies_to: Message schemas for policy and partner integrations

required_data_elements.business_definition: A message schema subject registered for a policy or partner integration.
The explicit version to which a consuming or producing integration pins a message schema.

method.summary: Confirm every message schema in use is registered and pinned to an explicit version.
steps: Enumerate message schemas referenced by policy and partner integrations.
Confirm each schema is registered in the schema registry.
Confirm each integration pins the schema to an explicit version.
Report unregistered schemas and the percentage of schemas version-pinned.
method.fallback_logic: If either source is unavailable, mark Not Run and raise a Missing Source item rather than passing.

thresholds.materiality_basis: Any unregistered or unpinned message schema is a conformance exception.

warning_criteria: Some schemas are registered but not yet version-pinned.
fail_criteria: One or more message schemas are not registered.
exception_handling: Register and version-pin the affected schemas and re-test.

downstream_linkage.staleness_rule: Must be re-evidenced each release before schemas are promoted to production.

actions_on_fail: Notify API Product Owner and Integration Architect
